title: 第十三章 抵押物就是我！-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
第(1/3)页

    只是没有想到，今天因为某些原因，爻雪提前关门歇业了，当他们赶到的时候，看到的就是紧闭的大门。

    “哥你看那边，好像又有人来了。”不远处的一栋建筑内，一名身材消瘦的男子对着旁边的长相跟他十分相似的男人说道。

    闻言，男人仅仅只是看了那些人一眼便收回了视线，说道：“看穿着打扮应该是附近大学的大学生。”

    “他们好像是朝着那家店的方向去了，我们要不要去提醒一下？”身材消瘦的男子说道。

    “有什么好提醒的，正好让他们去给咱们探探路。”男人声音冷静地说道。

    他们之前也是想要进去的，只不过他们被最开始的那个人给吓住了，便想着多让几个人进去探探路，没有想到今天这家店铺竟然将关门的时间给提前了。

    这段时间，不少人都因为这家店的存在朝着这边聚拢，人越来越多的同时，被吸引而来的怪物也越来越多了。

    白天的时候还好，一到了晚上，即便是他们所有人联合在一起，也只能够勉强应对而已，更不要说，原本对付怪物的主力已经没有了，能够想象得到，今天晚上绝对会是一场恶战。

    此时不少人也已经意识到了这个问题，已经开始陆陆续续的离开了，准备在今天晚上找个安全的落脚点，等到天亮了之后再过来。

    当然，还有另外一个原因就是，他们手里的食物不多了。

    另一边，那群人来到游戏商店的门前，看着关闭的大门，其中一个短发的女生见状，走到门后，伸手轻轻叩响了大门。

    “咚咚咚。”

    商店内，正在看末世小说的爻雪听到敲门声之后，将手里的小说放下，起身去开门。

    之前因为着急去看秘境，所以就提前把门给关了，后来放弃独自一人探索秘境，她就也没有想着重新将门打开，就当是给自己放假了。

    打开门，就看到一群看上去有些邋遢的人站在门口，随着门被打开，一双双清澈又略带疲惫和希冀的眼神看向她。

    “欢迎光临游戏商店，请进。”
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

They just didn’t expect that due to some reasons, Yaoxue would close early today. When they arrived, what they saw was the closed door.

“Brother, look over there, someone seems to be here again.” In a building not far away, a thin man said to the man next to him who looked very similar to him.

Hearing this, the man just glanced at those people and then withdrew his gaze and said: "Looking at their clothes, they should be college students from a nearby university."

"They seem to be heading in the direction of that store. Should we go and warn them?" said the thin man.

"If you have anything to remind us, just ask them to explore the way for us." The man said calmly.

They wanted to go in before, but they were frightened by the first person, so they thought about letting a few more people go in to explore the way. They didn't expect that the store would close earlier today.

During this time, many people gathered here because of the existence of this store. As more and more people came, more and more monsters were attracted.

It was okay during the day, but at night, even if all of them united, they could only barely cope. Not to mention, the main force that originally dealt with the monsters was gone. As you can imagine, it will definitely be a fierce battle tonight.

At this time, many people have also realized this problem and have begun to leave one after another, preparing to find a safe place to stay tonight and wait until dawn before coming back.

Of course, another reason is that they don’t have much food in their hands.

On the other side, the group of people came to the door of the game store and looked at the closed door. Seeing this, one of the girls with short hair walked behind the door, stretched out her hand and knocked on the door gently.

"Dong dong dong."

In the store, Yaoxue, who was reading a post-apocalyptic novel, heard a knock on the door, put down the novel in her hand, stood up and opened the door.

Because she was anxious to see the secret realm, she closed the door in advance. Later, when she gave up exploring the secret realm alone, she didn't even think about opening the door again and regarded it as a holiday for herself.

When she opened the door, she saw a group of slovenly-looking people standing at the door. As the door was opened, pairs of clear, tired and expectant eyes looked at her.

"Welcome to the game store, please come in."
